title: The Bride With Nine Shadows | A Korean Ghost Tale (Gumiho)
description:
A lonely scholar is taken in by a beautiful stranger on a fog-bound mountain road. But her shadow does not move the way a woman's should. A retelling of the Korean tale of the Gumiho, the nine-tailed fox.

Source: traditional Korean folklore (구미호 설화), as commonly retold.

scenes.narration: They say some roads should not be walked after dark. On a mountain pass thick with fog, a young scholar had lost his way, and the last light was bleeding out of the sky.
highlight: should not be walked after dark
scenes.image_prompt: a lone scholar in traditional Korean hanbok on a narrow mountain path swallowed by thick fog at dusk, fading light, lonely and ominous
scenes.sfx: cold wind through pines, distant crow, uneasy silence

scenes.narration: Just as despair set in, a single lantern glowed between the trees — a small tiled house that had not been there a moment before. At the gate stood a woman of impossible beauty. 'You must be frozen,' she said softly. 'Come inside.'
highlight: had not been there a moment before
scenes.image_prompt: a lone traditional Korean tiled house glowing with one lantern deep in a foggy forest at night, a beautiful woman in white waiting at the wooden gate, eerie warm light
scenes.sfx: a creaking gate, a single soft wind chime, held breath

scenes.narration: She fed him warm rice and poured him wine, and never once did she blink. 'Stay the night,' she whispered. 'Stay, and you need never be lonely again.' The scholar, warmed and weary, began to believe her.
scenes.image_prompt: candlelit interior of an old Korean house, a pale beautiful woman watching a seated scholar with an unblinking stare, flickering shadows, intimate and unsettling
scenes.sfx: crackling candle, faint unsettling hum, a bowl set down

scenes.narration: But as the candle guttered low, he saw it on the paper wall — her shadow. It was not the shadow of a woman. Behind her spread nine long tails, fanning slowly across the floor.
scenes.image_prompt: a woman's silhouette on a paper screen wall by candlelight, but the shadow shows nine fox tails fanning out across the floor, horror reveal, cold blue moonlight
scenes.sfx: a candle hiss, a low animal breath, rising dread

scenes.narration: He forced a smile and rose slowly. 'I must fetch water from the well,' he said. Her eyes followed him to the door — and did not look away. 'Don't wander far,' she murmured. 'The mountain is hungry tonight.'
scenes.image_prompt: a frightened scholar backing toward a wooden door while a pale woman watches with glowing eyes, moonlit Korean courtyard beyond, tense atmosphere
scenes.sfx: soft footsteps, a floorboard creak, heartbeat-slow tension

scenes.narration: He ran. Down the fog-drowned path he fled, not daring to look back — and behind him, the lantern light simply vanished, as if the house had never been. Only a long, echoing cry followed him down the mountain.
highlight: as if the house had never been
scenes.image_prompt: a man running down a foggy moonlit mountain path, the glowing house vanishing into darkness behind him, motion and fear, cold palette
scenes.sfx: running footsteps, a distant unearthly cry, rushing wind

scenes.narration: He reached his village by dawn, white-haired and trembling. The elders only nodded. 'You met her,' they said quietly. 'Few who do come back.' And to this day, travelers on that pass keep their eyes on the ground — and never count the shadows.
scenes.image_prompt: an exhausted white-haired man at the edge of a quiet village at misty dawn, old elders watching gravely, somber muted light
scenes.sfx: soft morning wind, a distant temple bell, quiet unease
